data.name: Yogendar
data.gender_notes: Yogendar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Yogendar is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Yoga' and 'Dharma'. It means 'One who leads with the discipline of Dharma'. Dharma is the law of the universe, the natural order of things, and Yoga is the practice of self-discipline and union with the divine. The name Yogendar carries the meaning “Discipline of Dharma” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Yogendar usually hope their child will grow to embody discipline of dharma and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Yogendar is a name for those who lead with spiritual wisdom and the discipline of Dharma. It is a name for spiritual leaders and teachers, and those who seek to live a life in harmony with the natural order of the universe.
data.etymology: Yogendar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Discipline of Dharma.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Yogendar total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
